title: Isolation Station: Algebra for Chemistry — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Rearrange chemistry equations step by step, then plug in the numbers. Pick an operation (× ÷ + −, ×(−1), x² and √ of both sides, expand, factor, 1/x flip, log, 10ˣ, ln, eˣ, swap) and tap a piece; it is applied to both sides, so every move is real algebra. 61 equations sorted by course and chapter (density, moles, molarity, dilution, all gas laws, specific heat, light and photon energy, percent yield, pH/pOH/Kw, Henderson–Hasselbalch, zero-, first-, and second-order integrated rate laws, Arrhenius, Gibbs free energy, Nernst, kinetic energy, rms speed, Graham's law, van der Waals, the Rydberg equation solved for n, isotope abundance and Raoult's law with x and 1 − x, hot metal dropped in water (q metal = −q water) solved for c, mass, starting temperature, or final temperature, weak-acid [H3O+] = √(Ka·C), Ksp = s², and more) in five levels: × ÷, + −, Mixed, x² √, and Logs. Coaching after every move, two-step hints that explain why, a step-by-step Show Me How, and a fewest-moves goal. After solving, students plug in realistic values with unit-conversion traps (°C to K, mL to L, nm to m, J to kJ), sig-fig coaching, and common-mistake feedback (flipped fraction, wrong power of 10, sign). A built-in practice calculator with TI-36X Pro-style keys (fraction and exponent templates, multi-tap ln/log and eˣ/10ˣ, EE, (−), ans, toggle) that can play each problem's keystrokes step by step, plus TI-36X Pro keystrokes for every plug-in problem (EE, (−), parentheses, the □/□ fraction key), with calculator-mistake feedback (extra ×10 with EE, PEMDAS slips). XP, ranks, achievements, an Equation Sheet with constants and an 'undo moves' table, and matched ItsDrDan videos. Opens in CHEM 1A; add ?course=3A or ?course=1B. Equation engine adapted from Dr. U's Equation Rearranger (FCC-Chem tools).
